provenance: PR #52 review round 2, finding R9. The D6 repair inserted 10 lines into specs/decisions/ADR-021-benchmark-instrument.md and thereby falsified line refs BELOW the insert — including two inside the very Debt row written to enumerate stale references by file:line, and three more in tasks/TODO.md:178, a row the diff never touched. This is the SECOND recorded occurrence of an ADR insertion silently invalidating ledger line refs in this repo; the pending ADR-019 line-ref item is the first. A line number is a pointer with no checksum. A line number PLUS a quotation of the sentence it means is self-verifying, and this check verifies it on every gate run — see the wiring note below, because for one commit it did not. WATCHED RED BEFORE THE FIX: on the tree at 52843af it reported two failures — tasks/TODO.md:178 citing ADR-021:379 for a sentence that had moved to :389, and tasks/TODO.md:195 citing specs/001-sec10k-contract.md:133 for a sentence at :157, a PRE-EXISTING stale ref that no review round had flagged and that the class sweep for R9 found. Adjacency is the discriminator: a quotation immediately after the ref is a quotation OF it. Matching any quote within the same sentence produced four false positives on the committed tree; matching adjacently produces none. FAILS CLOSED on min_refs (PR #52 R11's lesson applied pre-emptively to a second instrument): rewriting the rows to drop their quotations would drop the coverage silently, so the count of verifiable refs is committed. LIMIT, STATED SO IT IS NOT MISTAKEN FOR COVERAGE: 9 of the roughly 60 file:line citations in tasks/TODO.md quote their target and are therefore checkable. A bare `src/sec10k/web/app.py:126` with nothing quoted beside it cannot be verified by any means short of re-reading the author's intent; the remedy is to quote it when the row is next touched, and min_refs is what stops the quoted population from shrinking in the meantime. An existence-only rule over the bare refs was tried and rejected: six of them are deliberate shorthand (app.py:127, segment.py:508, normalize.py:271, prompts/008, prompts/009, boilerplate._demo) that no path resolution should be asked to reconcile. HOW THE RED WAS OBSERVED — CORRECTED UNDER PR #52 R14, WHICH CAUGHT THIS SENTENCE OVERSTATING ITSELF. The pre-fix red quoted above was observed by CALLING THE CHECK FUNCTION DIRECTLY, not by running the suite. That distinction is not pedantic: this case shipped without an `input.checks` key, `run_case` silently defaulted to `adr_headers`/`adr_index`, and the gate therefore reported [PASS] on a tree where this check was red — a case that could not fail, counted in the suite total. Fixed at the root by deleting that default, so a repo_hygiene case naming no check now fails loudly. RE-OBSERVED THROUGH THE RUNNER after the wiring fix, `python3 -m evals.run --suite invariant`: a wrong line number (:389 -> :399) gives [FAIL] ledger-line-refs, invariant 60/61; deleting a quotation gives [FAIL] via the min_refs floor, 60/61; altering a quotation gives [FAIL], 60/61; the clean tree gives [PASS], 61/61. FLOOR RAISED 9 -> 11 on 2026-08-26 (D9, ADR-034): the two Debt rows this milestone rules on now cite specs/decisions/ADR-034-pointer-and-fanout-rulings.md by line and quote the ruling sentence they mean, so the ledger cannot drift away from the ruling silently. That is the ONLY gate coverage the D9 ruling has over its own content -- evals/bench --check-docs does not read specs/decisions/ADR-034 (DOC_FILES carries only ADR-021 among the ADRs) and matches only decimals, so every integer figure in ADR-034 is ungated; ADR-034 section h says so in those words rather than leaving it to be found. Re-observed red before the floor was raised: writing the second citation without backticks around path:line left it unmatched by LEDGER_LINE_REF_RE and the count stayed at 10, i.e. the coverage was silently one short of what the row appeared to promise; backticking it gave 11. The raised floor was then mutation-tested in all three directions it is supposed to catch, on the D9 citations specifically: pointing ADR-034:349 at :300 fails with 'does not contain the quoted'; rewording the quoted sentence from 'Two reasons' to 'Three reasons' fails the same way; deleting the second citation outright drops the count to 10 and fails on the floor. Restoring gives PASS. FLOOR RAISED 11 -> 14 on 2026-08-27 (D13, ADR-038): the three Debt rows this milestone rules on (TD-12, TD-149, TD-150) each cite specs/decisions/ADR-038-internal-pointer-adjudication.md by line and quote the ruling sentence they mean, and TD-12's and TD-14's citations INTO ADR-034 were re-pointed (:493 -> :509, :532 -> :561) because ADR-038's amendment notes inserted lines above them -- which is the third recorded occurrence of an ADR insertion invalidating ledger line refs, and the first the check itself caught before commit rather than a review round. As with D9, this is the ONLY gate coverage the D13 ruling has over its own content: evals/bench --check-docs does not read specs/decisions/ADR-038 (DOC_FILES carries only ADR-021 among the ADRs) and matches only decimals, so every integer figure in ADR-038 is ungated; ADR-038 section g7 says so in those words. Re-observed red before the floor was raised, on the D13 citations specifically: pointing ADR-038:12 at :112 fails with 'does not contain the quoted'; rewording TD-149's quoted sentence from 'more than TD-149 records' to 'more than TD-148 records' fails the same way; deleting TD-150's citation outright drops the count to 13 and fails on the floor. Restoring gives PASS.
